name: MicroPort NeuroTech Limited
summary: MicroPort NeuroTech Limited, established in 2004 and headquartered in Shanghai, develops, manufactures and sells neuro-interventional medical devices worldwide for cerebrovascular conditions. For hemorrhagic stroke it offers the NUMEN coil system, the Tubridge flow-diverting stent and the Willis stent graft, among others, while the APOLLO stent addresses intracranial atherosclerosis. For acute ischemic stroke it provides the Neurohawk thrombectomy device and the Tigertriever stent retriever.
